mostWorthwhile.text: The paper rider made the distinction between a travelling wave and the cord’s local movement clear and memorable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the bridge before adjusting the tension was least useful: it failed without explaining what was needed first.

surprise.text: The two broad loops with a nearly still point were an intriguing result of adjusting tension and speed.

arbitrary.text: The required order for fitting the bridge was not obvious when my first attempt failed, although its later purpose was explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the rider and the final comparison of notes made the mechanisms worth exploring, despite the unclear bridge timing.
